إشعار اختياري عند رصد تغيّرات بين الفحوصات المحلية.
تم رصد %1$d تغيّرًا بين الفحوصات المحلية.
سجّل MSI %1$d تغيّرًا بين آخر الفحوصات المحلية. افتح التطبيق لمراجعة التفاصيل والأدلة المتاحة. هذا تنبيه للمراجعة وليس حكمًا على سلامة أي تطبيق.
MSI status indicator. Tap to open monitoring controls.
Local monitoring is active for apps and Android security settings.

Monitoring is active because you enabled it. MSI observes app install changes and ADB/developer settings, and periodically rechecks device indicators. Android may delay some scans. MSI does not send scan data to a server.
Watch local app changes and selected security settings with a persistent notification while the service is running.
Monitoring is enabled. MSI observes app install changes and ADB/developer settings, with a fallback scan every few hours.
Monitoring is off. No background service is running.
No internet or Usage Access is needed. App names and scan results are not sent to a server.
Notification permission is required. Android may stop the service or delay scans because of battery and system restrictions. After a device restart, open MSI to start the service again.
